name: dev.codevisor/gmail
title: Gmail
description: Search, read, draft, send and organize email. Mail stays on your devices.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages. Returns compact summaries with message and thread ids.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Search conversations. Returns one compact summary per thread.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one message: headers, labels, plain-text body and attachment names. The body includes quoted history.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a whole conversation, oldest first, with quoted history trimmed from each message.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List the mailbox's labels with their ids and names.

tools.name: list_send_as
tools.description: List the addresses this account can send from: its own address and its Gmail send-as aliases. Pass one as from when writing.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft without sending it. Pass inReplyToMessageId to draft a reply in that message's thread; recipients and subject then default to the reply's.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Change a draft. Fields you leave out keep their current values.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a new message, or an existing draft by draftId. Requires the user's explicit approval: confirm must be true.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Send a reply in a message's thread, to its sender (or everyone with replyAll). Requires the user's explicit approval: confirm must be true.

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Archive messages or threads: remove them from the inbox.

tools.name: modify_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels by name or id on messages or threads.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label. Use / in the name to nest it under an existing label, such as Clients/Acme.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Rename a label, or change its color or visibility. Settings you leave out keep their current values. System labels such as INBOX can't change.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a label. Its messages stay in the mailbox and lose only that label. System labels can't be deleted.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark messages or threads as read.

tools.name: mark_unread
tools.description: Mark messages or threads as unread.

events.name: message.received
events.description: A new message arrived in the inbox. Mail you sent yourself is skipped.

skills.name: gmail
skills.description: Work in the user's Gmail safely: search, read whole threads, draft first, and send only with explicit approval.
